_: What each corpus cart does under libmoy -- the real C console and its LUA_32BITS VM. A RATCHET: a cart that stops running, animating or taking input fails the build; runs/animates also fail if a cart starts, asking for this file to be raised. Recorded as the AND of THREE runs, so a borderline cart is pinned at its weakest observed behaviour -- these are real carts with clocks and randomness, and a gate that flaps gets deleted rather than fixed. The carts are not in this repository (see conformance/p8_carts.py). `verdict` is what the IMPORTER says before writing (PICO8.md, the static verdict) -- a golden too, since the classifier is deterministic.
